description: List the cities and airports CheapCarRent search accepts, with the exact spelling. Each row has country, countryCode, city, cityParam, iata when there is an airport, hasAirport, alsoAccepted spellings and the city page URL. Filter with country (two-letter code), query (city, country, alias or airport code; accents ignored) and airports_only. Pass countryCode as country and cityParam as city to search_cars, or pass iata. An unknown country code returns an error with the covered country codes. An empty list for a query means the place is not covered; do not guess another spelling.

airports_only.description: true to list only places with an airport (rows that have an iata code).

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. ES or GR. Only places in this country are listed.

query.description: City, country, alternative spelling or airport code to look for, e.g. Malaga or AGP. Accents are ignored; exact matches come first.

name: list_locations
title: List cities and airports
